text: The research record documents Jennifer Brouhard as the strongest candidate in the District 2 Governing Board Member race. On November 1, 2023, Brouhard co-introduced an OUSD resolution titled "Standing Up for Palestinian and Israeli Kids" calling for a ceasefire and the release of hostages in Israel and Palestine. CAIR Action endorsed Brouhard in the general phase. By contrast, Arielle Fleisher's recorded responses include supporting Israel as a Jewish homeland, opposing delegitimizing its existence, and pledging full implementation of AB 715 with access to instructional materials and state enforcement resources. Fleisher is endorsed by the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club in the general phase. The comparison rests on Brouhard's concrete sponsorship of a local ceasefire resolution and a formal CAIR Action endorsement, set against Fleisher's documented pro-Israel statements and her AB 715 pledge.
